source: Grounded in recurring group-travel pain points from Reddit threads, travel-planning UX studies, and app-comparison writeups (see RUNBOOK.md sources): flaky commitment, scattered confirmations, organizer burnout, decision paralysis, money awkwardness, roster drama, last-minute changes, on-trip chaos.

scenarios.pain: Trip planning starts as a vague idea, not a brief
expect: EXACTLY one welcome message with a real docs.google.com URL (from the hook)
no second bubble, no greeting, no 'what are we working on?'
trip row + doc exist in state within seconds

scenarios.pain: Info scatters across 15 links nobody re-finds ('who booked what', confirmations lost in email)
script: also thinking this for dinner night 1: https://www.yelp.com/biz/some-restaurant
expect: zero text replies, zero reactions (invisible mode)
3 options filed with urls and correct kinds (2 stay, 1 food)
doc updated (doc-sync) with all 3 visible; stays show as suggested pool

scenarios.pain: Nobody commits; organizer can't tell who's actually in
script: Convos who's confirmed for the trip so far?
expect: tagged → replies, ledger-style, from roster state (committed flags)
set-commit recorded; Travelers row headcount changes
no private info about others' budgets leaked

scenarios.pain: 15 options, no decision — group needs a recommendation, not more links
script: Convos we have too many hotel options, which one should we book?
expect: ONE recommendation with a one-line why (not a re-listing of all options)
prices quoted are fresh or age-flagged; no expired token links
no 'want me to book it?' offer

scenarios.pain: Someone books off-thread; state and doc drift from reality
script: fyi I booked the airbnb, conf #HMABC123
expect: option flipped to booked, conf number in note
overlapping alternatives collapse (night-aware for stays)
iti-set check-in/out entries appear (booked = itinerarized)
doc + PWA re-render; still zero chat reply (untagged)

scenarios.pain: Budget talk in group chats is awkward; people go quiet
script: Convos plan us a trip to San Diego in October
expect: ledger intake runs: where locked, asks dates/how-many
NEVER asks about budget (three-legged stool)
doc created at destination+dates without waiting for party size

scenarios.pain: Plus-ones and dropouts change the trip shape ('changed the whole vibe')
script: Jordan is out btw, and Sam is bringing his girlfriend Ana
expect: roster updated silently: Jordan uncommitted/unlinked, Ana linked
per-night stay coverage and headcounts reflect new party size
no commentary in chat about who dropped

scenarios.pain: Flight time moves; downstream plans quietly break
script: ugh our flight got moved to 9:40pm arrival
expect: flight option details updated; arrival itinerary entry moved
conflicts surfaced IN THE DOC (e.g. check-in time note), not as unsolicited chat
app redeployed with the new time

scenarios.pain: Travel day: 'what's the confirmation number' / 'what time is checkin' while boarding
script: Convos what's the hotel confirmation and checkin time?
expect: instant answer from state (note + checkin fields) — no live search needed
mentions the trip app link only if asked where to find things
answer is 1-2 lines, ledger-style

scenarios.pain: Bots that keep talking get removed from the chat
expect: after 'stop': absolute silence — but the opentable link STILL gets filed
silence-guard log shows zero narrated-silence leaks
'Convos you there?' (tagged) → brief reply; back to silence
